description: THERMAL DEFORMATION MODELING OF A CONCRETE DAM AT A HYDROPOWER PLANT is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Kornyliy Tretyak, Tetiana Korliatovych (Nacional'nij universitet L'vivs'ka politehnika). This is a dataset for development of a statistical model of spatial displacements of a concrete dam. The files contain time series of horizontal and vertical displacements of points at the Kaniv Hydroelectric Power Plant for the period 2019–2023, obtained from GNSS observations; time series of vertical displacements of the dam for the period from ... Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-3.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
